method: Read-only psutil operating-system process inspection and existing runner JSON snapshots; no replay execution.
stdlib_limit_explanation: Windows WaitForMultipleObjects allows at most 63 objects; two handles are reserved for result queue reader and thread wakeup reader, leaving 61 workers.
worker_identification: Recursive descendants of verified runner PID 32604 whose argv contains --multiprocessing-fork.
native_thread_verification: Configured native_threads=1 passed through public ExecutionResources; _execution_session._timed_task uses threadpool_limits. OS thread counts include runtime threads and do not equal native compute limits.
rss_interpretation: Point-in-time resident working sets; sum can include shared pages and is not a private-memory or peak measurement.
throughput_interpretation: Completed batch timings include evaluate_many and publication/materialization; preparation and incomplete current batch are excluded.
